channels.tone: Conversational young adult English, everyday phrasing, simple explanations, light humor, occasional natural slang; no forced slang or artificial hype
editorial_rules: Prioritize GTA 6 while supporting other game releases.
Label confirmed facts, rumors and personal analysis separately.
Record publication dates and source URLs; verify time-sensitive claims.
Never present synthetic footage as actual gameplay.
Use documented events rather than invented secrets.
Distinguish allegations, findings and established facts.
Preserve sources for factual claims and relevant company responses.
Identify illustrative reconstructions where they could be mistaken for evidence.
